question: 9 月的成交总额是多少？
notes: 口径依据 R001/R002/R003：按 pay_time 归期，status in (paid,refunded)，取 orders.amount（已扣折扣）
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'

question: 9 月扣掉退款之后的净成交额是多少？
notes: 口径依据 R004：退款按订单支付时间归期扣减（而非按退款发生时间）
reference_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS amt FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'), r AS (SELECT SUM(rf.refund_amount) AS amt FROM refunds rf JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = rf.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','refunded') AND o.pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND o.pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01') SELECT ROUND((SELECT amt FROM g) - COALESCE((SELECT amt FROM r), 0), 2) AS net_gmv

question: 9 月每天的成交额分别是多少？
notes: 按天分组，仍需按 pay_time 归期；输出按日期排序
reference_sql: SELECT CAST(pay_time AS DATE) AS stat_date, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 9 月各个城市的成交额排名是怎样的？
notes: 口径依据 R005：city 可能为空，应归入"未知"而不是直接丢弃；按成交额降序
reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(u.city, '未知') AS city, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','refunded') AND o.pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND o.pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC

question: 9 月因为什么原因退款最多？各个原因的退款金额是多少？
notes: 退款金额按 refund_time 归期，与成交类指标的归期字段不同
reference_sql: SELECT reason, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds WHERE refund_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND refund_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY refund_amount DESC

question: 9 月新增了多少注册用户？
notes: 按 register_time 归期，与交易无关；整数计数必须完全一致
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS new_users FROM users WHERE register_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND register_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'

question: 9 月下单的订单里，最终完成支付的比例有多高？
notes: 这是转化率，按 create_time 归期，与成交类指标不同；比率指标容差取 1e-4
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pay_time IS NOT NULL THEN order_id END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 4) AS pay_conversion_rate FROM orders WHERE create_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND create_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01'

question: 9 月 VIP 用户和普通用户的客单价分别是多少？
notes: 客单价 = 成交额 / 订单数，按 pay_time 归期
reference_sql: SELECT u.is_vip, ROUND(SUM(o.amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','refunded') AND o.pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND o.pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 9 月卖得最好的 5 个商品是哪些？
notes: 商品维度只能用明细表，且必须减去 discount（订单级折扣已分摊到明细）；归期仍用 orders.pay_time
reference_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(i.unit_price * i.quantity - i.discount), 2) AS item_amount FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','refunded') AND o.pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND o.pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY item_amount DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 5

question: 9 月各个获客渠道的成交额是多少？和 8 月比怎么样？
notes: 两个月份的成交额并列输出，便于直接对比
reference_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_sep, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS gmv_aug FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid','refunded') AND pay_time >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01' AND pay_time < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv_sep DESC
